court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Smt. Kamlabai v. Smt. Rukminibai — full case name
facts_of_case: The Petitioner, Smt. Kamlabai, is the daughter-in-law of the Respondent, Smt. Rukminibai. The Petitioner claimed that she was being harassed and ill-treated by her mother-in-law. She sought a direction to the Respondent to treat her with kindness and respect.

legal_principles.principle: A testator's intention is the paramount consideration in construing a will.
legal_principles.held: It is well settled that the intention of the testator is the paramount consideration in construing a will. The court must, therefore, try to find out what was the intention of the testator and give effect to it.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the person who seeks to upset the natural meaning of a will.
legal_principles.held: It is well settled that the burden lies on the person who seeks to upset the natural meaning of a will and show that it was intended by the testator something different from what appears on the face of the document.

outcome.final_order: The Court directed the Respondent to treat the Petitioner with kindness and respect.
